scenes.q: Which floor number do Korean elevators often hide?

scenes.text: Four. It sounds like the word for death, so many elevators show F instead of four.
scenes.why: 4 sounds like the word for death, so elevators often show F instead.

Which floor number do Korean elevators often hide? 🛗
The 4th. 사 (four) sounds like the word for death, so many buildings show F instead of 4.
